caption:
Lulu's heels lift and the chest tips forward every time the squat goes deep. The ankles might be setting the limit.

As you squat, your knees need to travel forward over your toes. If the ankles don't bend enough, the heels lift or you stop short. It's common and very workable.

Hybi's 1-minute routine: kneel with your front foot a hand-width from a wall, heel down, and touch your knee to the wall. Compare sides. Rock the knee over the toes for 10 to 15 slow reps, then do a few squats straight away.

Stiffness since an old sprain, pinching at the front or swelling after training is worth an assessment. Our Sydney CBD and Chatswood physios can help. Book online via the link in bio.
